title: Girâ sumaq
intro: cankah adda xer, ellecabo numma yaybulleenim, roociini geytoh safar qemmisen. keenik aggiriqqe sinni kibal ken miraaciseh gexkalit xissiime seeratitte, foocal mango gibbatuy imaan waado gibbata. Ta roocih aydaadi qibaadah kalaluu ​​kee miracsenta sumaqta.
clues: Anu yi degeltak baxsale ammuntal barkat geeh, addâ xexxar kee baxsale fantaaxaw yaybulle.
Yok dumaahi mano taswiiritte bicsen marih fanat sugte, takkay immay yi sorkocô baxi Inki Numma Yalla lih suge.
Anu qaran dagar, ayro, alsa kee cutuuka, ken ugtumaa kee radim wagsiisak, yi Rabbi yakkem maduuda axcuk gaba kaleh.
fidin politheism sadih abtol, anu dirab rabbittet garaye, dubuk, kaxxa tiya tibba iyyeh malkise.
yi gexkalootu idolatry gibdi digaala fan gexe, anu naqabu le infernoh addat qideemih digaalah suge.
uxih, yi gineh amri, caylale hubuubigta xabca raceenah milaagimteeh, amaan le, yi mano dacrisak.
arabic: قَالُوا۟ ٱبْنُوا۟ لَهُۥ بُنْيَـٰنًۭا فَأَلْقُوهُ فِى ٱلْجَحِيمِ
verse: They said, "Construct for him a structure [i.e., furnace] and throw him into the burning fire." (37:97)
